description: Explore global democracy, executive constraints, judicial independence, freedom of expression, polarization, and corruption across 183 nations from 1900 to 2025 with complete V-Dem codebook features.
storymap_summary: Spatial analysis of global democratic health, institutional resilience, executive constraints, and authoritarian trends.
storymap_questions: How do executive constraints and judicial independence insulate nations against democratic backsliding? What geographic patterns emerge when comparing consolidating democracies versus autocratizing regimes?

description: Explore state-level civic engagement, youth voting, and mail ballot adoption trends across US presidential and midterm elections.
storymap_summary: Spatial investigation into congressional district boundaries, gerrymandering mechanics (cracking and packing), and voting access disparities.
storymap_questions: How do district geometries and boundary drawing dilute or amplify the voting power of demographic groups? How does state-level mail-in ballot policy correlate with turnout rates?

description: Compare public attitudes on climate policy, healthcare access, and voting rights across US geographic regions.
storymap_title: Spatial Dynamics of Public Opinion & Social Cohesion
storymap_summary: Explores geographic polarization, regional consensus on key policy debates, and spatial divergence in civic attitudes.
storymap_questions: How do regional cultures and local economies affect consensus on public policy? To what extent does geographic sorting reinforce political polarization?

description: Investigate how educational attainment, age brackets, and rural/urban settings shape voting and civic meeting attendance.
storymap_title: Civic Participation: Urban, Suburban & Rural Divides
storymap_summary: Examines neighborhood-level engagement, community meetings, and local political participation across the urban-rural continuum.
storymap_questions: Why do suburban and rural communities show distinct patterns of civic participation compared to urban centers? What role does educational attainment play in community meeting attendance?

description: Examine interpersonal trust, confidence in parliament, democratic satisfaction, and immigrant acceptance in European societies.
storymap_summary: Mapping social capital, trust in parliaments, and democratic satisfaction across European nations.
storymap_questions: Why does social trust remain significantly higher in Scandinavian societies compared to Southern and Eastern Europe? How does institutional trust protect against democratic erosion?

description: Explore relationships between GDP per capita, Gini inequality, life expectancy, education, and media trust across world regions.
storymap_summary: Investigates regional disparities in Gini inequality, human development indices, life expectancy, and civic well-being.
storymap_questions: Does rapid economic growth automatically translate into lower inequality and higher civic trust? Which regions exhibit high human development despite moderate GDP per capita?
